title: Daga ma'auni zuwa rigar da aka gama: sauƙi, karkiya, makada

say: Daga ma'auni zuwa rigar da aka gama: sauƙi, karkiya da makada.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module huɗu na Advanced Knitting da Crochet.
Tufafi ne inda ma'auni, resizing da siffatawa suka taru. Kuna farawa da jiki na gaske, kuma kuna zaɓi sauƙi da gangan. Sauƙi shine bambanci tsakanin jiki da rigar da aka gama.

say: Sa'an nan kuma ku lissafta karkiya zuwa sama, kuma ku gama da riguna masu kyau, makada da tarewa. Kyakkyawan kammalawa na iya ninka abin da abokin ciniki ke son biya.

say: Sama yana buƙatar ma'auni goma. Ɗauki bust ɗin a cikakken ɓangaren, tare da matakin tef duk zagaye. Sa'an nan kuma tsayin kugu, hip da baya.

say: Ƙara giciye baya, zurfin rami na hannu, hannu na sama, wuyan hannu, tsayin hannu, wuya, da tsayin rigar da take so.
Yi auna kan tufafi masu haske, bayyana kowannensu kafin ɗauka, kuma kiyaye katin a sirri. Rubuta kwanan wata, saboda jikin yana canzawa.

say: Misali, Chioma a Asaba tana saƙa madaidaicin madaidaicin tsalle ga abokin ciniki mai tsayin cm 98. Ta ƙara 8 cm cikin sauƙi, don ƙarewar ƙira na 106 cm. Gaba da baya sune 53 cm kowanne.

say: Ma'auninta shine stitches 22 a cikin 10 cm, don haka sau 53 2.2 shine 116.6. Ta zagaye 117 don dacewa da hakarkarinta. Hannu na sama shine 32 da 4 cm na sauƙi, 36 cm, wanda shine 79 dinki.

panel.heading: Chioma tana juya jiki zuwa dinki

say: Ta zana gaba, baya da hannun riga a matsayin siffofi masu sauƙi, kuma ta rubuta kowane lamba akan su. Wannan makirci shine shirinta da dubanta.

panel.heading: Chioma tana juya jiki zuwa dinki
panel.rule: Ƙarshen ma'auni x stitches a kowane cm = ƙidayar dinki.

say: Raglan sama-sama yana farawa a wuyansa. Layuka huɗu suna gudana zuwa ƙananan hannaye, kuma kowane zagaye na haɓaka yana ƙara dunƙule a bangarorin biyu na kowane layi, 8 dinki a zagaye.
Tare da sabon zaren a stitches 20 a kowane 10 cm, Chioma 50 cm wuyansa shine 100 dinki: 34 baya, 34 gaba, da 16 ga kowane hannun riga.

say: Gaba dole ne yayi girma daga 34 zuwa 98 dinki. Wannan shine ƙarin 64, 2 a kowane zagaye, don haka 32 yana ƙaruwa. Hannun hannu yana buƙatar 24 kawai, don haka bayan zagaye 24 ta ƙara a jiki kawai.

say: Dinka ya fi tsayi tsayi, don haka ba za ka iya ɗaukar dinki ɗaya a jere ba. Jagoran gama gari shine dinki 3 don kowane layuka 4.
Misali, Aisha a Ilorin tana da gefen layi 130. Rabon ta shine 22 zuwa kashi 30, kusan 0.73, don haka tana buƙatar kusan 95 dinki.

panel.heading: Aisha ta zabga guraren bututu guda shida

say: Tana son ɗigon maɓalli guda 6 na ɗinki 2, tare da ɗinki 3 a kowane ƙarshen. Abubuwan da aka bari a kan dole ne su raba ta 5, rata tsakanin ramukan. Tare da stitches 98, 80 sun ragu, kuma 80 an raba ta 5 shine 16.

panel.heading: Aisha ta zabga guraren bututu guda shida

say: Ta dauko 98 kuma ta raba ramukan 16 dinki. Sannan ta duba jimlar adadin ya koma 98.

say: Saƙa a ƙarshen da wutsiyoyi na akalla 15 cm, sa'an nan kuma toshe. Auduga da viscose suna shimfiɗawa lokacin da aka jika, don haka bushe su a kwance, ba su taɓa ratayewa ba.

cards.d: Tushen rigar. Suna mikewa lokacin jika da nauyi, don haka bushewa lebur, ba a rataye ba.
Jika ko tururi toshe. Babu ruwan zafi tare da shafa, ko yana iya ji kuma yana raguwa.
Kar a taɓa dannawa da ƙarfe mai zafi. Riƙe tururi a sama, kiyaye hannaye a sarari, kashe bango.

say: Don tunawa. Zabi sauƙi da gangan. Ƙarshen girman lokutan ma'aunin yana ba da ɗinki. Kowane raglan karuwa zagaye yana ƙara 8 dinki. Dauki kusan 3 don kowane layuka 4. Kuma toshe ta hanyar fiber, yin amfani da tururi tare da kulawa.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Girman da aka gama x ma'auni = dinki
Kowane zagaye raglan yana ƙara dinki 8
Toshe ta hanyar fiber; tururi da kulawa

say: Yanzu yi katin ma'auni da tsari, ƙididdige raglan ɗin ku tare da kowane rajistan da aka nuna, kuma ku gama ƙungiyar samfuri tare da maɓalli guda uku daidai gwargwado da alamar kulawa.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
